75369:
**Warning: This is the beginning of the final boss rush for Riku's side of the story. Save before approaching, and be prepared for the long-haul!**

**Recommended Level:** 40+

This fight can be extremely difficult without the proper command deck.

Almost all attacks, except for Poison Volley, can be avoided by staying in the air. Use Doubleflight and Air Slide whenever possible to stay out of reach, and use homing attacks like Dark Firaga or Triple Plasma to land hits on this slippery boss. Relying on Keyblade attacks can be frustrating and will take a lot of patience. Be careful with your timing and don't just spam attacks. The Anti Black Coat Nightmare will teleport so quickly, it can evade your Keyblade attacks mid-animation.

The biggest attack to look out for is when he'll drain your health and scatter it across the arena as green health orbs, that the Anti Black Coat Nightmare will pick up and use to heal himself. To avoid this, look for a dark line across the floor, dodging before it can touch you.
